title: Our new neighbour
evenTitle: When did you/will you go to ...?
evenTitleZh: 你过去/将在什么时候去……？

words.zh: 飞行（过去式 flew，过去分词 flown）

lines.en: Nigel is our new next-door neighbour.
lines.zh: 奈杰尔是我们新搬来的隔壁邻居。

lines.en: He will fly to New York next month.
The month after next he'll fly to Tokyo.
lines.zh: 再下个月他将飞往东京。

lines.en: At the moment, he's in Madrid.
He flew to Spain a week ago.
lines.zh: 他是一星期以前飞到西班牙的。

lines.en: He'll return to London the week after next.
lines.zh: 再下个星期他将返回伦敦。

lines.en: He's only forty-one years old, and he has already been to nearly every country in the world.
lines.zh: 他只有 41 岁，但他却去过世界上几乎每一个国家。

lines.en: Nigel is a very lucky man.
lines.zh: 奈杰尔是个很幸运的人。

lines.en: But his wife isn't very lucky.
lines.zh: 但他的妻子运气不很好。

drills.en: He went to Beijing last year. → He ___ go to Beijing next year.

drills.zh: 你下周去雅典吗？不，我下周不去雅典。

drills.en: I went to Paris the year before last. → I will go to Paris the year ___ next.
He will fly to New York next month. The month after ___ he'll fly to Tokyo.
drills.zh: 下个月他飞往纽约，再下个月飞往东京。

drills.en: He flew to Spain a week ___.
drills.zh: 他一星期以前飞到西班牙的。

drills.en: He'll ___ to London the week after next.
drills.zh: 再下个星期他将返回伦敦。

drills.en: Nigel is a ___. He flies planes.
drills.zh: 奈杰尔是个飞行员。他开飞机。

drills.zh: 他去过世界上几乎每个国家。
